# Creative MCP

> Creative MCP is an open collection of local Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI agents and MCP clients to creative software: Adobe MCP for InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere Pro, and Blender MCP for Blender. Servers run on the user's own machine over stdio; nothing is hosted.

Key facts:
- Adobe MCP: five app-specific Node.js servers (Node.js 18+, macOS or Windows) plus a Suite coordinator for two documented Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. npm: `adobe-mcp-suite`; Homebrew: `brew install zachshallbetter/tap/adobe-mcp`. Source: https://github.com/zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp (MIT).
- Blender MCP: a Rust MCP server and CLI with a companion Blender add-on (Blender 4.0+). Homebrew: `brew install zachshallbetter/tap/blender-mcp` (v0.5.0). Source: https://github.com/zachshallbetter/blender-mcp-rs (MIT OR Apache-2.0).
- The projects are independent. A client can load both, but moving files between Adobe apps and Blender is a user-managed handoff.
- Capability status is reported as Documented, Implemented, Tested or Validated; those levels are distinct and a lower level never implies a higher one.
- Created by Zach Shallbetter (https://zachshallbetter.com/).
- Website, docs and the series catalogue (https://creativemcp.com/registry.json) are open source at https://github.com/zachshallbetter/creative-mcp.
- Each tool has its own repository and release cycle; they share the Homebrew tap `zachshallbetter/tap`. One installer sets up the series: `brew install zachshallbetter/tap/creative-mcp` then `creative-mcp setup` (detects apps and MCP clients, installs, registers, verifies; macOS fully supported). The installer is built from the catalogue.

The full text of every page below is in [llms-full.txt](https://creativemcp.com/llms-full.txt).

## Start here

- [Creative MCP — creative tools, connected](https://creativemcp.com/): Open, local MCP servers that let AI agents work in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere Pro and Blender. Install with Homebrew.
- [Projects](https://creativemcp.com/projects.html): Adobe MCP and Blender MCP compared: what each open MCP implementation connects to, what it needs and where to start. Both run locally on your machine.
- [How it works](https://creativemcp.com/how-it-works.html): How Creative MCP works: your MCP client starts a local server, the server talks to your creative app, and your files never leave your computer.
- [Get started](https://creativemcp.com/start.html): Get exact setup commands for Adobe MCP or Blender MCP in your MCP client, or let the Homebrew installer detect your apps and set everything up.
- [About Zach Shallbetter](https://creativemcp.com/about.html): Meet Zach Shallbetter, the artist, designer and creative technologist behind Creative MCP, open local tools that connect AI agents to creative software.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/): Creative MCP documentation for Adobe MCP and Blender MCP: setup, content guides, MCP API, CLI, configuration and implementation references.
- [Getting Started](https://creativemcp.com/docs/getting-started.html): Setup, configuration, workflows, troubleshooting and safety guidance for Creative MCP implementations, including Adobe MCP and Blender MCP.
- [Content & capability guide](https://creativemcp.com/docs/content.html): What each Adobe MCP server works on, and how an Adobe feature, an automation route, an MCP tool and a live-verified workflow differ.
- [MCP API reference](https://creativemcp.com/docs/api.html): How the Adobe MCP servers expose tools over stdio: discovery, tool metadata, calls, results, execution boundaries and where to find exact parameters.
- [CLI & configuration](https://creativemcp.com/docs/cli.html): The creative-mcp installer: setup, doctor, update, add and remove. Plus launch commands, Suite app selection and configuration for each server.
- [Architecture & distribution](https://creativemcp.com/docs/architecture.html): How the Creative MCP series fits together: one repository per tool, the Homebrew tap, the creative-mcp installer, the shared catalogue and rules for new tools.
- [Contribute](https://creativemcp.com/docs/contributing.html): Contribute an implementation or workflow to Creative MCP with accurate scope, setup, capability and evidence documentation.

## Implementation guides

- [Adobe MCP](https://creativemcp.com/apps.html): Adobe MCP gives InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere Pro their own local MCP servers, plus a coordinator for two cross-app handoffs.
- [InDesign implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/indesign.html): Drive InDesign from an AI agent: pages, typography, tables, styles, images, long documents and export. How the MCP server connects, its conventions and setup.
- [Illustrator implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/illustrator.html): Drive Illustrator from an AI agent: artboards, layers, paths, type, color, effects, symbols and export. How the MCP server connects, its conventions and setup.
- [Photoshop implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/photoshop.html): Drive Photoshop from an AI agent: layers, masks, selections, adjustments, filters, type and export. How the MCP server connects, its conventions and setup.
- [After Effects implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/aftereffects.html): Drive After Effects from an AI agent: compositions, layers, keyframes, expressions, effects, text and the render queue. Setup, connection and configuration.
- [Premiere Pro implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/premiere.html): Drive Premiere Pro from an AI agent: sequences, timeline edits, markers, effects, captions and export, through a local UXP bridge. Setup and configuration.
- [Suite coordinator implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/suite.html): The Adobe MCP Suite coordinator runs the app servers together and automates two handoffs: placing Illustrator artwork and copying swatches into InDesign.
- [Shared core implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/core.html): The shared core behind every Adobe MCP server: argument and path safety, script execution, structured results, tool annotations and static script auditing.
- [Blender MCP implementation](https://creativemcp.com/docs/implementations/blender.html): Blender MCP pairs a Rust MCP server with a Blender add-on so AI agents can work with scenes and assets. Install with Homebrew; setup and safety notes.

## Optional

- [Capability Atlas](https://creativemcp.com/capability-atlas.html): A researched map of 12,014 documented features across five Adobe apps: which can be automated, by what route, which MCP tools cover them, and the evidence.
- [Features](https://creativemcp.com/features.html): Search the Adobe MCP feature inventory across InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere Pro, with routes, tool mapping and evidence.
- [Workflows](https://creativemcp.com/workflows.html): Worked examples of Adobe MCP and Blender MCP in real creative projects, with automated steps and human-managed handoffs clearly marked.
- [Privacy](https://creativemcp.com/privacy.html): What creativemcp.com measures with Google Analytics, what it stores in your browser, and how to opt out. The local tools send nothing to this site.
